markdown.headingText: function to rename NHGIS codes to corresponding labels
markdown.markdown:
```{r} library(tidyverse) library(rvest) library(dplyr) library(readr) library(stringr) library(janitor) library(tigris) library(scales) options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE) ``` ```{r} lines <- read_lines("nhgis0002_ds272_20245_county_codebook.txt") IPUMS_data <- read_csv("nhgis0002_ds272_20245_county.csv") NRHP_LHAT_theaters <- read_csv("../data/Theaters/NRHP_LHAT_joined.csv") operas <- read_csv("../data/Theaters/opera_america_members.csv") colleges <- read_csv("../data/Colleges/joined_colleges.csv") auto_ev_facilities <- read_csv("../data/Industrial Institutions/auto_ev_map.csv") ``` ```{r} rename_nhgis_codes <- function(data) { data %>% rename( total_population = AUO6E001, race_total = AUO7E001, white = AUO7E002, black = AUO7E003, american_indian_alaska_native = AUO7E004, asian = AUO7E005, native_hawaiian_pacific_islander = AUO7E006, other_race = AUO7E007, two_or_more_races = AUO7E008, education_total_25plus = AUQ8E001, bachelors_degree = AUQ8E022, masters_degree = AUQ8E023, professional_degree = AUQ8E024, doctorate_degree = AUQ8E025, median_household_income = AURUE001 ) } ``` ```{r} IPUMS_data <- IPUMS_data %>% mutate( GEOID = str_pad(as.character(TL_GEO_ID), width = 5, pad = "0") ) IPUMS_data <- rename_nhgis_codes(IPUMS_data) ``` ```{r} IPUMS_data <- IPUMS_data %>% mutate(GEOID = as.character(TL_GEO_ID)) %>% mutate(GEOID = str_pad(GEOID, 5, pad = "0")) counties_sf <- counties(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m", year = 2024) ``` ```{r} # join population data to spatial boundaries counties_map <- counties_sf %>% left_join(IPUMS_data, by = "GEOID") %>% filter(!is.na(total_population)) %>% # drop territories/areas with no match st_transform(crs = 4326) # population color palette population_pal <- colorNumeric( palette = "YlOrRd", domain = counties_map$total_population ) # adding popup labels labels <- sprintf( "%s
Population: %s
Median HH Income: $%s", counties_map$NAME_E, format(counties_map$total_population, big.mark = ","), format(counties_map$median_household_income, big.mark = ",") ) %>% lapply(htmltools::HTML) ``` ```{r} colleges %>% select(College, State, Latitude, Longitude, City, college_type) %>% filter(!is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Longitude)) college_pal <- colorFactor( palette = c("LAC" = "#2166ac", "HBCU" = "#b2182b"), domain = colleges$college_type ) college_labels <- sprintf( "%s
%s
Type: %s", colleges$College, colleges$City, colleges$college_type ) %>% lapply(htmltools::HTML) ``` ```{r} leaflet() %>% addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>% setView(lng = -98.5, lat = 39.8, zoom = 4) %>% # county choropleth layer addPolygons( data = counties_map, fillColor = ~population_pal(total_population), weight = 0.5, opacity = 1, color = "white", fillOpacity = 0.7, label = labels, labelOptions = labelOptions( style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "3px 8px"), textsize = "13px" ), highlightOptions = highlightOptions( weight = 2, color = "#666", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE ), group = "Counties" ) %>% addLegend( pal = population_pal, values = counties_map$total_population, opacity = 0.7, title = "Total Population", position = "bottomright" ) %>% # college point layer addCircleMarkers( data = colleges, lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude, radius = 5, color = ~college_pal(college_type), stroke = TRUE, weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0.9, label = college_labels, labelOptions = labelOptions( style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "3px 8px"), textsize = "12px" ), group = "Colleges" ) %>% addLegend( pal = college_pal, values = colleges$college_type, title = "College Type", position = "bottomright" ) %>% # toggle layers on/off addLayersControl( overlayGroups = c("Counties", "Colleges"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE) ) ``` ```{r} # writing function to join IPUMS variables with institution datasets join_ipums <- function(data, lon, lat, counties, ipums) { # convert to sf object data_sf <- data %>% filter( !is.na(.data[[lon]]), !is.na(.data[[lat]]) ) %>% st_as_sf( coords = c(lon, lat), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE ) # match CRS data_sf <- st_transform(data_sf, st_crs(counties)) # spatial join to counties data_county <- st_join( data_sf, counties, join = st_within ) # join NHGIS/IPUMS demographics data_ipums <- data_county %>% left_join(ipums, by = "GEOID") return(data_ipums) } ``` ```{r} # applying function to each institution dataset theaters_IPUMS <- join_ipums( NRHP_LHAT, lon = "longitude", lat = "latitude", counties = counties, ipums = IPUMS_data ) operas_IPUMS <- join_ipums( operas, lon = "longitude", lat = "latitude", counties = counties, ipums = IPUMS_data ) colleges_IPUMS <- join_ipums( colleges, lon = "Longitude", lat = "Latitude", counties = counties, ipums = IPUMS_data ) auto_ev_IPUMS <- join_ipums( auto_ev_facilities, lon = "longitude", lat = "latitude", counties = counties, ipums = IPUMS_data ) ``` ```{r} # applying function to all datasets IPUMS_data <- rename_nhgis_codes(IPUMS_data) theaters_IPUMS <- rename_nhgis_codes(theaters_IPUMS) operas_IPUMS <- rename_nhgis_codes(operas_IPUMS) colleges_IPUMS <- rename_nhgis_codes(colleges_IPUMS) auto_ev_IPUMS <- rename_nhgis_codes(auto_ev_IPUMS) ``` ```{r} # load county shapefile counties <- counties(cb = TRUE, year = 2024, class = "sf") %>% st_transform(4326) # join income data to counties counties_income <- counties %>% left_join( IPUMS_data %>% select(GEOID, median_household_income), by = "GEOID" ) counties_income_no_na <- counties_income %>% filter(!is.na(median_household_income)) # check missing values sum(is.na(counties_income$median_household_income)) ``` ```{r} # comparing distributions of median household income by county income_compare <- bind_rows( theaters_IPUMS %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(type = "Historic Theater") %>% select(type, median_household_income), colleges_IPUMS %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(type = "College") %>% select(type, median_household_income), auto_ev_IPUMS %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(type = "Auto/EV") %>% select(type, median_household_income) ) ggplot(income_compare, aes(type, median_household_income, fill = type)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal() ``` ```{r} # make sure GEOID is character in both datasets counties <- counties %>% mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID)) IPUMS_data <- IPUMS_data %>% mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID)) # join IPUMS variables to all county polygons counties_IPUMS <- counties %>% left_join(IPUMS_data, by = "GEOID") %>% rename_ipums() # apply function to new counties dataset counties_IPUMS <- rename_ipums(counties_IPUMS) income_pal <- colorNumeric( palette = "viridis", domain = counties_IPUMS$median_household_income, na.color = "transparent" ) counties_IPUMS %>% summarise( total_counties = n(), missing_income = sum(is.na(median_household_income)) ) ``` ```{r} # mapping median household income & colleges leaflet(counties_IPUMS) %>% addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>% addPolygons( fillColor = ~income_pal(median_household_income), fillOpacity = 0.7, weight = 0.4, color = "white", popup = ~paste0( "Median household income: $", comma(median_household_income) ), group = "County Median Income" ) %>% addCircleMarkers( data = colleges_IPUMS %>% filter(college_type == "LAC"), lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude, radius = 4, color = "black", weight = 1, fillColor = "blue", fillOpacity = 0.9, popup = ~paste0( "", College, "
", "Type: LAC
", "Median household income: $", comma(median_household_income) ), group = "LACs" ) %>% addCircleMarkers( data = colleges_IPUMS %>% filter(college_type == "HBCU"), lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude, radius = 4, color = "black", weight = 1, fillColor = "red", fillOpacity = 0.9, popup = ~paste0( "", College, "
", "Type: HBCU
", "Median household income: $", comma(median_household_income) ), group = "HBCUs" ) %>% addLegend( position = "bottomright", pal = income_pal, values = ~median_household_income, title = "Median Household Income" ) %>% addLayersControl( overlayGroups = c("County Median Income", "LACs", "HBCUs"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE) ) ```
